name: documentation-triptych
title: Documentation Triptych
description: Three-pane technical documentation layout: directory tree sidebar, main article, and table of contents rail.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Three Pane Doc Navigation: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
